notes: Covers the 2019 Townie Original 7D EQ step-thru, from one spec page for that year; other years and the step-over frame may differ.

gaps: The front hub is listed only as Shimano Nexus Dynamo 32H w/QR, with no hub model number and no wattage or voltage on the page, so none is claimed.
The 44T chainring is from the features list; the spec rows give only the crankset.
Brakes (linear pull, no maker named) are not listed: the template has no brake part.
The steel uni-crown fork is not listed as a part.
Other model years and the step-over frame were not checked.
method: Specs are from the BikeRoar spec page "Electra Townie Original 7D EQ Step-Thru (2019) Specs".
The researcher reported that Trek product pages gave no spec text and that 99spokes returned HTTP 403; neither is cited.

comps.spec: Taya Octo 1/2 x 3/32 in nickel-plated chain; forged alloy 170 mm crankset with a 44T chainring; Shimano 7-speed cassette, 14-34T
Shimano Tourney TX-35 rear derailleur, shifted by a Shimano Revo 7-speed twist shifter
Shimano Nexus Dynamo front hub, listed as 32H with QR
Spanninga front and rear LED lights, hub-dynamo powered
Schwalbe Big Ben 26 x 2.15 in tyres with a puncture-resistant Kevlar guard casing
Townie 6061-T6 aluminium frame with Flat Foot Technology, step-thru
